label: No own favouring has a merely produced stand-in for a non-present candidate
paraphrase: OPEN source-of-differences bridge, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every bearer b with a favouring determination, every scenario s and every candidate x that is not a present input at s, b's stand-in for x is not an item that b produces without containing it. Rationale: to produce distinct items for x and y the bearer would already have to discriminate x from y (a common principle must contain what distinguishes its effects; ST I q.14 a.6, navigation only), and that contained discrimination, not the produced item, is then the first stand-in. It excludes a realm of possibles that the source makes and that then guides its favouring.
